sources.articleTitle: Temperature dips to 22.8 deg C in Scotts Road amid heavy rain, West Coast flash flood

headline: Singapore Records Temperature Drop And Flash Floods Amid Heavy Rain
seoTitle: Singapore Experiences Flash Floods And Lower Temperatures
metaDescription: Singapore faces heavy rainfall leading to flash floods in the West Coast region and a notable temperature drop to 22.8 degrees Celsius at Scotts Road.
aiSummaryBullets: A temperature decrease to 22.8 degrees Celsius was reported at Scotts Road during the afternoon.
Heavy rainfall triggered flash flood conditions in the West Coast area of Singapore.
The meteorological observation regarding the temperature drop was officially recorded at 3:02 pm.
aiContextParagraph: Singapore experienced significant weather changes on November 10, 2026, as heavy rain impacted parts of the island. According to local reporting, the inclement weather was associated with a notable reduction in temperatures, with a low of 22.8 degrees Celsius measured at Scotts Road around 3:02 pm. Concurrently, public alerts and local reports indicated that the persistent precipitation resulted in flash flooding within the West Coast district. While such weather events are periodically monitored by local authorities for their impact on urban infrastructure and public transit, this specific instance highlights the intensity of the rainfall during this period. The situation drew public attention as citizens observed the shift in environmental conditions and reported localized inundation in affected western sectors of the city-state, prompting interest in regional weather updates throughout the day.
whyItIsViral: The story gained traction due to a high volume of public search queries related to flood conditions in Singapore following the afternoon rainfall.
